description: Column and enum glossary for NL / semantic query over db/food_health.duckdb. Keys are table.column. See ontology.json for concepts and relationships; this file is the flat lookup for a specific column.

slchd_portal.title: Salt Lake County Health Department food inspection portal
slchd_portal.notes: Source of establishment_keys, inspections, violations, violation_codes.

ucsd_google_local.title: UCSD Google Local dataset (Utah subset)
ucsd_google_local.notes: Source of establishments, establishment_attributes, establishment_categories, gmap_hours, review, category.

nominatim.title: OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoder
nominatim.notes: Second-pass geocoder for addresses the Census geocoder couldn't match.

establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_k.description: Primary key. Derived: upper(trim(name) || '|' || trim(address) || '|' || city). Not an official permit id.

establishment_keys.source.description: Which of two independent scrapes produced this listing.

values.friend_slc: Relational scrape with full inspection + violation-level detail (1245/1341 listings).
values.own_scrape: Establishment-info + inspection-summary scrape only, no violation line items (96/1341 listings).

establishment_keys.slchd_lat.description: Geocoded latitude for the SLCHD address. Null for 71/1341 rows (no geocoder could resolve the address).

establishment_keys.slchd_lon.description: Geocoded longitude for the SLCHD address. Null for 71/1341 rows.

establishment_keys.geocode_status.description: Outcome of geocoding this row's address.

values.Match: Resolved by the Census batch geocoder.
values.Tie: Census geocoder found multiple equally-plausible matches; kept but ambiguous.
values.Match_Nominatim: Census geocoder found nothing; resolved by the Nominatim second pass.
values.No_Match: Neither geocoder could resolve this address; slchd_lat/slchd_lon are null.

category.category_id.description: Primary key for a Google Places category tag.

category.category.description: Category label text, e.g. 'Pizza restaurant', 'ATM'. Broader than cuisine — includes non-food venue/amenity tags picked up at mixed-use locations.

establishments.gmap_id.description: Primary key. Google Maps place id.

establishments.description.description: Google's short editorial blurb for the place. Null for ~48% of rows.

establishments.geom.description: Point(longitude, latitude), DuckDB spatial GEOMETRY. Built at load time from meta.latitude/longitude by scripts/load_duckdb.py — data/final/establishments.csv carries plain latitude/longitude columns instead of geom, since CSV has no geometry type.

establishments.avg_rating.description: Google average star rating for the place.

establishments.price.description: Google price-level symbol, repeated per tier (e.g. '$', '$$$'). Null for ~35% of rows. A few rows use '₩' instead of '$' — a source scrape quirk, not a different currency; use symbol repeat-count as the tier signal.

establishments.slchd_establishment_key.description: Nullable FK to establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key, set only when entity resolution matched this Google Local place to an SLCHD listing (139/8592 rows). Null means no known inspection history — not an error.

establishment_attributes.attribute.description: One Google-reported feature/amenity tag (e.g. 'Delivery', 'Wheelchair accessible entrance'). Free text, hundreds of distinct values, no fixed vocabulary. The outer grouping label Google provides (e.g. 'Service options', 'Accessibility') was dropped during cleaning — only the leaf value is kept.

gmap_hours.day.description: Day of week for this hours span.

gmap_hours.open_max.description: Closing time. If less than open_min, the span crosses midnight (e.g. opens 11AM, closes 1AM).

review.rating.description: Star rating for this individual review — distinct from establishments.avg_rating, which is the place-level aggregate.

review.resp.description: Owner response text, if the establishment replied to this review.

inspection_types.inspection_type_id.description: Primary key, parsed from the leading number in the source string (e.g. '01 - Routine' -> 1). Values 4-6 don't occur in the data — a gap inherited from the source portal, not missing rows.

inspections.inspection_id.description: Primary key, surrogate (bigserial). Not present in the source data.

inspections.slchd_establishment_key.description: FK to establishment_keys.slchd_establishment_key. Always set — every inspection belongs to a known SLCHD listing.

inspections.inspection_type_id.description: Nullable FK to inspection_types.inspection_type_id. Null for 27 inspections where the source recorded no type.

inspections.inspection_score.description: Total violation points for this inspection. 0 = clean. Higher = worse (confirmed: inspections with any cited violation average score 17.6 vs 1.7 for clean ones).

violation_codes.violation_code_id.description: Primary key, surrogate (serial). Not present in the source data.

violation_codes.code_text.description: Utah Food Code section reference with trailing asterisks stripped, e.g. '4.5.18'.

violation_codes.asterisk_count.description: Count of trailing '*' on the original raw code (e.g. '4.5.18*' -> 1). Correlates with the critical flag but its official meaning per the Utah Food Code was not independently verified — treat as an observed pattern, not a confirmed rule.

violation_codes.critical.description: Whether citations of this code are critical. One fixed value per code — verified across all citations, no code has mixed critical/non-critical citations. (3 codes were found inconsistently labeled in the raw source and were normalized to critical=true; see data/processed/clean_processed.ipynb, 'Fix inconsistent violation criticality'.)

violations.violation_id.description: Primary key, surrogate (bigserial). Not present in the source data.

violations.inspection_id.description: FK to inspections.inspection_id. An inspection with zero citations has zero rows here — absence means clean, not missing data.

violations.violation_description.description: Inspector's free-text note for this specific citation. Varies per occurrence even for the same code (median 8 distinct descriptions per code) — do not assume it's constant for a given violation_code_id.

violations.violation_occurrences.description: Repeat count of this violation within the inspection. Usually 1.

violations.violation_cos.description: Whether this violation was corrected on site during the inspection.

violations.violation_phr.description: Public health rationale / rubric label (raw portal category text). 1:1 with violation_code_id for 234/237 codes; 3 codes have more than one observed phr. Join to semantic/violation_map.csv on this column to get the normalized violation_type bucket used for agent reasoning.
